read.thesis: Eaton's Q3 beat and third guidance raise: Electrical Americas margin hit 29.8% (+230bp QoQ) as 18 of 25 capacity projects finished, with electrical backlog above $20bn, up 46%.

capex.quote: New capacity is turning into output, and output into earnings.

triggers.label: Expansion projects 18 of 25 complete
triggers.quote: 18 of our 25 expansion projects are complete, with the steepest part of the ramp behind us.

triggers.label: Organic growth guide raised to 13-15%
triggers.quote: we now expect total company organic growth to be between 13% and 15%, up 200 basis points at the midpoint

triggers.label: Electrical backlog +46% to >$20bn
triggers.quote: Our total electrical backlog reached another record of more than $20 billion, up 46% from last year.

triggers.label: General price increases effective Jan 2027
triggers.quote: we would have general price increases in EA, EMEA, and GIS effective January 2nd.

triggers.label: Aerospace supplier constraints on backlog
triggers.quote: we face some specific supplier issues in some commodities. There are punctual problems.

guidance.quote: we now expect total company organic growth to be between 13% and 15%, up 200 basis points at the midpoint
we now expect full-year EPS to be between $13.70 and $13.80, $13.75 at the midpoint
We are maintaining our total segment guidance range of 24.1%-24.5%.
raising Boyd's full-year revenue to $1.9 billion, of which $1.6 billion will be in Eaton's books
we see at least a $2.7 billion business for next year, which is roughly 50% growth

prior_guidance_check.quote: raising Boyd's full-year revenue to $1.9 billion

red_flags.label: Aerospace supplier constraints delaying backlog conversion
red_flags.quote: we face some specific supplier issues in some commodities. There are punctual problems.

red_flags.label: Electrical Americas margin decline from commodity costs
red_flags.quote: the majority of the margin decline was driven by temporary commodity cost headwinds

evasions.quote: We are not ready to share the 2027 guidance yet
the timing of that transition is not under our control
